notes.title: Added Option to Run Setup to change Controls.
notes.notes:
Added the option to run setup, this will allow you to set different Controls. Just run the Setup Launcher for each version you want to change. I have only tested Keyboard and Mouse not the other control options.

Additional changes: dos4gw to v2.01a and dosbox-staging to v0.82.2

notes.title: Fixing 3D-stereoscopic mode
notes.notes: Apparently I broke 3D-stereoscopic when fixing the mouse movement. Should be fixed now.

notes.title: Adding Version 1.73 and Fixing Mouse Movement
notes.notes:
We found Version 1.73 in the bin of old CDs. I could not find any notes on what was changed.

Mouse controls should now work.

Updated the DOSBox Staging config file.

notes.title: Version 1.6 Release
notes.notes:
I removed Version 1.5 as it was shareware and not the official game.

Added version 1.6 and updated the launcher to a command line to keep with the retro style.

notes.title: Adding version 1.5
notes.notes:
Adding Version 1.5 has a option to play.

Version 1.4 includes an improved sound/timer driver and runs 15% to 20% 
faster.

Version 1.5 fixes a problem with the time clock and includes improved enemy
AI.
